verdict.rationale: doola documents company formation, annual report filing, EIN workflows, and registered-agent service in all 50 states. Nothing in the evidence mentions foreign qualification, meaning registering an existing company to do business in an additional state. Registered-agent coverage and annual-report filing are adjacent services, not the foreign-qualification filing itself.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
